# SwarmUI compatibility

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_compat_doc.py from tools/data/param_probe.json and crates/comfy-server/src/todo_nodes.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

This covers every parameter SwarmUI exposes, every prompt-syntax feature, and every ComfyUI node class SwarmUI's workflow generator can emit, all checked against this backend.

**This page is about the server, not real generation.** "Works" means the workflow validates and ran on the mock engine. For what the native engine really generates, see [STATUS](../../docs/STATUS.md).

It was measured, not guessed. `tools/probe_swarm_params.py` drove a live SwarmUI that was pointed at comfy-server. For each parameter it generated the workflow with and without that parameter, for each of the five target models, and diffed the two. Each case that changed the workflow was then run end to end through SwarmUI on the mock engine (the **Ran** column).

**241 parameters probed:** 136 work natively, 23 work through the generic `custom_node` route, 0 are blocked, and the rest never reach the backend for these models (handled inside SwarmUI, or they only act together with another parameter).

## Native and generic support

Every node class SwarmUI can emit is either implemented natively or has a schema here, so every workflow SwarmUI builds validates and runs:

- **Native**: the server implements the node, lowering it to typed engine requests, patches and metadata (see [INPUT_MAPPING.md](INPUT_MAPPING.md)). This covers everything SwarmUI does with the five target models.
- **Generic** (89 node classes, listed below): other model families' stock ComfyUI nodes and third-party node packs. The schemas live in [`crates/comfy-server/src/todo_nodes.json`](../crates/comfy-server/src/todo_nodes.json). Stock schemas come from a real ComfyUI dump; third-party ones are written in `tools/third_party_schemas.py`. At startup the server asks `Engine::supports_custom_node(class)` for each. Claimed classes are registered with that schema and listed in `/object_info`, which makes SwarmUI enable the matching features. They execute through `Engine::custom_node`, with their resolved inputs and with model-file combos resolved to files. The mock engine claims all of them and returns typed placeholder outputs; run it with `--mock-native-only` to turn that off.
- An unclaimed class fails validation before anything runs. The `missing_node_type` error names the node, its area and the parameters behind it, and SwarmUI shows it to the user. `--advertise-todo-nodes` lists unclaimed schemas in `/object_info` anyway, for inspecting workflows; running them still fails validation.
- To make a node native: register it under `crates/comfy-server/src/nodes/` (a native schema always wins), remove it from `tools/todo_catalog.py`, then regenerate (see the end of this file).

**Needs** column (what native support would take):
- *server*: pure data work the server can do itself (images, masks, ints).
- *server + engine flag*: the server records a new patch or metadata field (for example on `ModelPatch` or `CondMeta`), and the engine has to honor it while sampling.
- *engine op*: needs a new `Engine` method.
- *new arch*: belongs to supporting another model family.

## Parameter matrix

Status values:
- **Works**: the workflow only uses natively implemented nodes.
- **Generic**: the workflow also needs generic-route nodes (listed in **Via custom_node**). It works when the engine claims them; it ran on the mock.
- **Blocked**: the workflow needs a node with no schema at all.
- Anything else explains why the parameter did not change the workflow for these models.

**Reaches** lists the node inputs that changed and the implemented nodes that were added. These are the fields the engine has to honor; see [INPUT_MAPPING.md](INPUT_MAPPING.md) for what each one becomes in the engine API.

Model keys: `krea2` = Krea 2, `anima` = Anima, `minimax_h3` = MiniMax H3, `moss` = MOSS, `qwen21` = Qwen 2.1.

## Prompt syntax

| Syntax | Status | Models | Via custom_node | Reaches | Ran | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<region:x,y,w,h>` | Works | all |  | `ConditioningCombine`, `ConditioningSetMask`, `DifferentialDiffusion`, `SwarmCleanOverlapMasksExceptSelf`, `SwarmExcludeFromMask`, `SwarmSquareMaskFromPercent` | yes |  |
| `<object:x,y,w,h>` | Works | all |  | `ConditioningCombine`, `ConditioningSetMask`, `DifferentialDiffusion`, `SwarmCleanOverlapMasksExceptSelf`, `SwarmExcludeFromMask`, `SwarmSquareMaskFromPercent` | yes |  |
| `<segment:text>` | Works | all |  | `CropMask`, `DifferentialDiffusion`, `GrowMask`, `ImageScale`, `ReferenceLatent`, `SetLatentNoiseMask`, `SwarmClipSeg`, `SwarmImageCompositeMaskedColorCorrecting` ... | yes |  |
| `<segment:yolo-model>` | Works | all |  | `CropMask`, `DifferentialDiffusion`, `GrowMask`, `ImageScale`, `ReferenceLatent`, `SetLatentNoiseMask`, `SwarmImageCompositeMaskedColorCorrecting`, `SwarmImageCrop` ... | yes |  |
| `<clear:text>` | Works | all |  | `JoinImageWithAlpha`, `SwarmClipSeg`, `SwarmMaskBlur`, `SwarmMaskThreshold` | yes |  |
| `<extend:frames>` | Works | all |  | `AudioConcat`, `CLIPTextEncode`, `ImageBatch`, `ImageFromBatch`, `ImageScale`, `LTXVSeparateAVLatent`, `MiniMaxH3SigmaShift`, `SwarmCountFrames` ... | yes |  |
| `<refiner>` | Needs other params |  |  |  |  | Swaps the prompt for the refiner stage only. |
| `<base>` | Works | all |  | `CLIPTextEncode.text`, `SwarmTextEncodeAdvanced.prompt` | yes |  |
| `<video>` | Works | all |  | `CLIPTextEncode`, `ImageFromBatch`, `ImageScale`, `LTXVSeparateAVLatent`, `MiniMaxH3SigmaShift`, `SwarmEmptyMiniMaxH3LatentAV`, `SwarmMiniMaxH3AddKeyframes`, `SwarmSaveAnimationWS` ... | yes |  |
| `<videoswap>` | Works | all |  | `CLIPTextEncode`, `ImageFromBatch`, `ImageScale`, `LTXVSeparateAVLatent`, `MiniMaxH3SigmaShift`, `SwarmEmptyMiniMaxH3LatentAV`, `SwarmMiniMaxH3AddKeyframes`, `SwarmSaveAnimationWS` ... | yes |  |
| `<pixeldecoder>` | Only applies to other model architectures |  |  |  |  | Pixel decoder models. |
| `<break>` | Works | all |  | `SwarmTextEncodeAdvanced`, `SwarmTextEncodeAdvanced.prompt` | yes |  |
| `<lora:name:weight>` | Works | all |  | `LoraLoader`, `LoraLoaderModelOnly` | yes |  |
| `<embed:name>` | Works | all |  | `SwarmTextEncodeAdvanced`, `SwarmTextEncodeAdvanced.prompt` |  | Not run live: the probe has no embedding file, so SwarmUI refuses the request itself. Parsing is covered by the engine-api prompt tests. |
| `<alternate:a,b>` | Works | all |  | `SwarmTextEncodeAdvanced`, `SwarmTextEncodeAdvanced.prompt` | yes |  |
| `<fromto[0.5]:a,b>` | Works | all |  | `SwarmTextEncodeAdvanced`, `SwarmTextEncodeAdvanced.prompt` | yes |  |
| `<weight[1.5]:text>` | Works | all |  | `SwarmTextEncodeAdvanced`, `SwarmTextEncodeAdvanced.prompt` | yes |  |
| `<trigger>` | SwarmUI-side only: never reaches the backend |  |  |  |  | Expanded to the model's trigger phrase by Swarm. |
| `<comment:text>` | SwarmUI-side only: never reaches the backend |  |  |  |  | Stripped by Swarm. |

Wildcards, `<random>`, `<repeat>`, `<preset>`, `<var>`/`<setvar>`, `<macro>`/`<setmacro>` and `<param>` are resolved inside SwarmUI before the workflow is built. They only ever change prompt text or parameter values.

## Regenerating

Run these from `swarm backend/`, with SwarmUI and ComfyUI cloned to `reference/SwarmUI` and `reference/ComfyUI`, both gitignored.

1. Start a stock ComfyUI on CPU with SwarmUI's extra nodes, and save its `/object_info`:
   `python main.py --cpu --port 8199 --extra-model-paths-config <yaml with custom_nodes: .../ComfyUIBackend/ExtraNodes>`
2. Save comfy-server's own `/object_info` twice: started with `--mock-native-only` (ours.json), and without it (full.json, which adds the generic-route nodes).
3. Run `python tools/swarm_inventory.py real.json ours.json inventory.json`, which scans SwarmUI's generator source.
4. Run `python tools/third_party_schemas.py`, then `python tools/gen_todo_nodes.py real.json inventory.json` to write `todo_nodes.json`. It fails if SwarmUI can emit a node that is neither implemented nor classified in `tools/todo_catalog.py`.
5. Restart comfy-server (full mock), start SwarmUI with fake model files (see [ADDING_MODELS.md](ADDING_MODELS.md)) and its session id in `scratch/session`, then run `python tools/probe_swarm_params.py ours.json tools/data/param_probe.json --run --generic full.json`.
6. Run `python tools/gen_todo_nodes.py real.json inventory.json tools/data/param_probe.json`, then `python tools/gen_compat_doc.py`.
